Veterinary Oncology Services
At Golden Gate Veterinary Specialists, we understand that discovering your beloved pet has cancer is a challenging and emotional moment. Our team of dedicated specialists are here to support you and your pet every step of the way through this journey. We recognize the difficulty of this situation, and we are fully committed to guiding you with compassion and expertise.
When it comes to cancer treatment, our veterinary oncologist,
Dr Ruppel treats pets from across Marin, San Francisco, Sonoma, Napa, and the surrounding bay area
.  She is committed to crafting personalized treatment plans that are designed to mitigate the impact of the disease on your pet's life, with the ultimate goal of extending and enhancing their quality of life.
Oncology consultations start with a comprehensive evaluation of your pet. Results from this examination will guide our recommendations as we discuss the options for treatment.  These options may include chemotherapy, immunotherapy, radiation therapy, surgery, or a combination of these methods. As cancer treatments continue to advance with new information and technology, our team works to provide up-to-date knowledge, treatment plans and access to available clinical trials. Every patient is unique, and we provide you with a range of therapies that best meet your needs and the specific needs of your pet.
At Golden Gate Veterinary Specialists, we also offer a comprehensive suite of advanced diagnostic and therapeutic procedures through our veterinary oncology department, including:
A caring and compassionate team approach
State-of-the-art diagnostic imaging
including x-rays, ultrasound and computed tomography (CT scan) by board-certified radiologist
Thorough Comprehensive Laboratory Testing (blood, urine, cultures, etc.)
Aspirates and biopsies to help determine extent of disease or obtain a more definitive diagnosis
Registered veterinary technicians specifically trained and experienced with the administration of chemotherapy
Intravenous, intralesional and intracavitary chemotherapy administration
Melanoma vaccine and other immunotherapy treatments
Palliative care and pain management
Discussion of new diagnostics, treatments and clinical trials
Collaboration with other specialists to help coordinate additional diagnostics and treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy and endoscopy.
At Golden Gate Veterinary Specialists, your pet's well-being is our ultimate priority, and we're here to provide the highest level of care and expertise for their health needs. Our commitment to excellence in canine and feline cancer care, encompassing cancer including lymphoma,
osteosarcoma, hemangiosarcoma, sarcoma / soft tissue sarcoma, carcinoma, bladder cancer, liver cancer, lung cancer, skin cancer, melanoma and more
. Trust us to guide your beloved companions toward a healthier, brighter future.
